_comment: First-pass abusive-language list for customer reviews. Matched on whole words/phrases after lower-casing, accent stripping (Yoruba tone marks), leetspeak mapping (0->o, 1->i, 3->e, 4->a, 5->s, 7->t, @->a, $->s), collapsing repeated letters and '*' masks, so 'fuuuck', 'sh1t' and 'f*ck' all hit. A match only HIDES the review pending an admin look; it is never a ban. Keep this list high-precision: words that are also ordinary vocabulary or names (soup, thief, dull, towns and surnames such as Olodo or Jaki) are deliberately left out, the report flow covers those. Add words here or through the REVIEW_ABUSE_EXTRA_TERMS setting. Entries are lowercase; multi-word entries are phrases.
